priorDecisions.title: Fix lights-out: pick a time, take 7.5 h
priorDecisions.predict: Back at 7.5 h, the press third set returns to 7 and the loss keeps coming off fat rather than lean.

priorDecisions.predict: The 320 debut lands on a clean week and sticks first time; nothing you own gets contested on recovery grounds.

priorDecisions.title: Leave the calorie band alone - that drift is your step taper
priorDecisions.predict: Holding the band keeps the rate inside 1.0-1.4 lb/wk, and the maintenance fit settles near 2,470 once a clean post-seal fortnight replaces the frozen reads.

priorDecisions.title: Extension: open harder — one rep in the tank, not two

apply.to: Extension 150: take set 1 to ~1 RIR until 9,9 lands

priorDecisions.predict: Next lower day the opener lands 9 and the pair reaches 9,9, reopening 155 within two sessions.

priorDecisions.title: Fix your leg-day cards before you train — they're showing July 21
priorDecisions.predict: Set calves to 320, hack to 160 and abs to 100 on the cards before your first set and today's leg day banks as owned. Leave them and you'll repeat 315 and a hack you outgrew nine days ago, and none of it will count.

priorDecisions.title: Press 250: get the coach flag — you owned 245 on Thursday

apply.to: Press 250 — raise with your coach for the structural flag, then debut

priorDecisions.predict: 5 lb on 245 is 2%, which by your app's own reps-per-load slope costs about eight-tenths of a rep — expect 250 to open at 7 and land near 7,7,6, then climb back to 8,8,7 over two or three clean sessions.

priorDecisions.title: Strike Friday's ham curl — your note says you skipped it
priorDecisions.predict: The ham entry comes off Friday's session or lands in that day's skipped list, the top-of-window counter goes back to zero, and ham holds at 120 until you put up 12,12 on a session you actually ran.

priorDecisions.title: Extension 155: debut it, and treat 9,8 as a win

apply.to: Extension 155 — debut on the next lower day; 8,8 or better counts as a clean debut

priorDecisions.predict: 155 opens near 9 and lands around 9,8. Anything at or above 8,8 is a clean debut and 155 stays. Set two is where it fell over in July — 9 then 6 — so that is the number to watch.

suggestions.title: Protect sleep: aim 7.5 h, cap afternoon caffeine

rationale.science: At equal deficits, 5.5 vs 8.5 h sleep cut fat loss 55% and raised lean-mass loss 60% (Nedeltcheva 2010).
rationale.data: Last 13 nights average 7.2 h (7-night debt 1.8 h); 4 recent days had >=300 mg or afternoon caffeine.
rationale.relationship: Short sleep + late caffeine track with your low recovery score and rep dips - the lever that protects lean while you cut.

suggestions.predict: Higher share of loss as fat; lean protected; better session quality.
